newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks close easier, Pernod-Ricard tumbles.
newsitem.headline: French stocks close easier, Pernod-Ricard tumbles.

text.p: French stocks closed slightly lower on Friday in profit-taking ahead of the monthly settlement on Monday, traders said.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index finished down 2.87 points, or 0.14 percent, at 2,079.46, off its session lows, while the CAC-40 September futures contract fell six points to 2,082.50.
For the week, the CAC index was down 0.4 percent as the bourse consolidated its strong previous gains.
Volume on Friday was 4.23 billion francs.
Pernod-Ricard's stock was the biggest loser on the CAC 40, shedding 5.28 percent to 278.30 francs.
Several brokerage houses lowered their ratings and earnings forecasts for the drinks group after it reported a drop in first-half operating profit on Thursday evening.
Aluminium group Pechiney's shares finished up 3.50 francs at 216.80 after the company announced plans to lower costs by four billion francs, mostly through the elimination of 4,000 to 5,000 jobs.
